series.title: Keep it out of the way
series.sub: Hide the bar in some apps, while you type, or until media plays

steps.title: Open Visibility
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, under Advanced features, tap Visibility.

steps.title: Choose when it shows
steps.text: Two switches: only while media plays, or only during calls. Leave both off and it is always there.

steps.title: Pick what happens as you type
steps.text: Move above the keyboard, hide, or stay put. Moving, it can glide, spring or bounce out of the way.

steps.title: Type in another app
steps.text: In any app, as the keyboard comes up the bar springs above it, and goes back when you are done.

steps.title: Pick apps to hide it in
steps.text: Back in Visibility, tick the apps where it should step aside. Here, Video.

steps.title: There, it steps aside
steps.text: Open Video and the bar is gone. Leave it, and the bar is back.

steps.title: Show it on the lock screen
steps.text: Turn on Show on the lock screen and the bar is there too, for volume and quick toggles.
